deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}" = "creative-vibrancy" ] || [ -n "${PREPROCESS_SOURCES:-}" ]; then python main.py --preprocess-until-empty --sources ${PREPROCESS_SOURCES:-reolink}; else gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8080} --workers 2 --threads 4 --timeout 180 --limit-request-line 0 app:app; fi'
